:::EV Page 0, ff
+sn;
Serial Number;
string;
;
Serial number of the VSL, unique to this device suggested for UD: UDV0001, UDV0002, etc (UDV for VSL or Vehicle not to confuse with EVSE VELs);
;
;
+vv;
VEL Version;
string;
;
VEL version and variant, example vv52b_1;
5.2b_1;
;
:::EV Info, 2
+vn;
VIN Number;
string;
length, 20;
Not needed if Canbus interface gives VIN to VSL on demand;
;
;
+id;
Unique EV Identifier;
string;
;
May not be needed is available, however, a separate unique ID may be provided here;
;
;
+ma;
Make;
string;
length, 20;
Manufacturer of the car;
;
;
+mo;
Model;
string;
length, 20;
Model name of the car;
;
;
+uf;
Upfitter;
string;
;
Upfitter or car modifying company name, e.g. 'Autoport';
;
;
+cn;
Connector Inlet;
string;
;
e.g. J1772 or IEC62196-2;
;
;
+mc;
Maximum Charge Rate of Car;
integer;
range, 0, 1000;
Maximum charge rate of car in amperes (minimum of inlet, cable, carger/PEU, etc.);
;
;
+md;
Maximum Discharge Rate of Car;
integer;
range, 0, 1000;
Maximum discharge rate in amperes, zero if cannot discharge;
;
;
+b0;
Battery Zero Capacity (kWh);
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
Battery zero capacity in kWh;
;
;
+bf;
Battery Minimum Offset kWh;
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
Minimum battery offset in kWh;
;
;
+bc;
Battery Maximum Offset kWh;
integer;
range, -1000, 0;
Maximum battery offset in kWh;
;
;
+bk;
Battery kWh;
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
Maximum usable capacity of battery in kWh;
;
;
+ie;
Ideal battery kWh;
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
Ideal capacity of battery in kWh;
;
;
+mr;
Maximum Range;
integer;
range, 0, 500;
Maximum range in miles to use if calculation not available (may be depreciated when VSL starts calculating range);
;
;
+lp;
Low Power;
undetermined type;
;
A cut-off voltage for the 12V battery below which the VEL board will switch off;
;
;
+gf;
GIV Dispatch Flags;
undetermined type;
set, 00, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07;
A set of flags that control dispatch while grid integrated: 01 ANTI-ISLANDED, 02 DISABLE_CHARGING_DISPATCH, 04 DISABLE_DISCHARGING_DISPATCH, Set to 06 to disable charging and discharging.;
00;
;

Utility ID;
unicode;
length, 20;
The EIA id of the load-serving entity, find these under EIA-861 data files, 'File1', which is updated yearly.;

Utility Name;
unicode;
length, 128;
short name;

System Operator;
unicode;
length, 20;
Name of the TSO or ISO (e.g. PJM, ERCOT, CalISO, Energinet.dk, etc.);

;
+po;
Pole ID;
unicode;
length, 20;
Number of pole or connector nearest to this service drop;
;
;
+ts;
Transformer Serial Number;
unicode;
length, 30;
Nearest transformer to this EVSE circuit (may be utility or customer owned);
;
;
+tp;
Transformer Power Rating;
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
The rated kVA of the nearest transformer;
0;
;
+df;
Distribution Feeder;
unicode;
length, 128;
The name of ID used by the local utility for the medium voltage supply;
;
;
+sb;
Substation Name;
unicode;
length, 128;
Substation name, id, or number;
;
;
+si;
Service Drop Meter Serial Number;
unicode;
length, 20;
Utility meter number for building or site;
;
;
+bi;
Submeter id;
unicode;
length, 20;
May be a label or a serial number, optional, but if >1 EVESE on this submeter, then 'bi' required for all and must be identical for all;
;
;
+pa;
Panel Amperes;
integer;
range, 0, 10000;
Breaker amps for the whole panel in which the EVSE is wired. For residential, this is typically the service drop amp capacity;
0;
;
+ca;
Circuit Amperes;
integer;
range, 0, 1000;
Nominal circuit breaker amperes for the circuit with this EVSE;
0;
;
+cl;
Circuit Label;
unicode;
length, 20;
the number (or other label if present) for the breaker feeding this EVSE.  If only one EVSE per circuit, this is an optional assist for service, but if one breaker has >1 EVSE, it is requred that all EVSEs have 'cl' and that all are exactly matching unicodes;
;
;
+vo;
Voltage Nominal;
integer;
range, 0, 600;
Nominal voltage for the circuit feeding the EVSE.  Critical setting, used to set backfeeding target voltage;
0;
;
+rf;
Reverse Feeding Permitted;
unicode;
set, 1, 0, 01, 00;
Whether an EV is allowed to send power back to the grid at this EVSE location, 1 means true, 0 or absent means false;
;
;
+mt;
Meter Type;
unicode;
set, NOT-PRESENT, UD, EKM-25 v.2, EKM-Omni v.3, EKM-Omni v.4, EKM-Omni v.4-3ph, YTL-D113003;
The type of meter in the EVSE.;
;
;
+ms;
Meter Serial Number;
unicode;
;
Serial number of internal EVSE meter, if applicable (UD internal meter will probably use Milbank EVSE serial number as it's meter serial number, thus not needed to be entered here);
;
;

IP Address;
unicode;
;

;
;
+su;
Subnet Mask;
unicode;
;
Subnet mask (su, gw and dn are present only if not DHCP;
;
;
+gw;
Gateway;
unicode;
;
Gateway;
;
;
+dn;
DNS list;
unicode;
;
DNS list, with IP's separated by semi-colons, e.g. dn128.175.74.219;128.175.24.84;
;
;
:::EVSE Labeling and Optional Data, 6
+es;
EVSE Serial Number;
unicode;
length, 30;
EVSE Name, Serial number of EVSE;
;
;
+en;
EVSE Name;
unicode;
length, 30;
EVSE Name, number or other label written on this EVSE; use only if this is visible to user. This should be unique within the building or parking lot but probably will not be unique in wide area. Use mfgr serial number in DFlash page 0, not this, to uniquely identify this EVSE.;
;
;
+la;
Latitude;
unicode;
;
The GPS latitude of this EVSE (optional and may be in server not here);
;
;
+lo;
Longitude;
unicode;
;
The GPS longitude of this EVSE (optional and may be in server not here);
;
;
+ga;
Altitude;
string;
regex, '''^-?\d+\.\d+$''', 0;
Altitude of the EVSE;
;
;
+on;
Owner Name;
unicode;
;
Default name for initial owner when this EVSE first registers itself. Not used if this is not a valid user on this aggregator and/or OCCP server;
;
;

unicode;
length, 128;
If present, this supercedes value in code;

If present, this supercedes value in code;
